sources.title: Qwen3-1.7B-Base — specs, VRAM, license, benchmarks | LocalLLMs
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3-1.7B-Base is an open-source large language model developed by Alibaba's Qwen team and released in 2025. As part of the third generation of Qwen models, it delivers strong performance in text generation and conversational tasks while maintaining a compact 1.7 billion parameter footprint.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The Qwen3 series includes models of both dense and Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) architectures, with parameter scales ranging from 0.6 to 235 billion. A key innovation in Qwen3 is the integration of thinking mode (for complex, multi-step reasoning) and non-thinking mode (for rapid, context-driven responses) into a unified framework.
